info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/trellis-2/retexture
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/trellis-2/retexture queue.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the reference image for texturing

texture_size.title: Texture Size
texture_size.description: Resolution of the texture image baked onto the mesh. Higher values capture finer surface details but produce larger files.

tex_slat_sampling_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation. More steps = slower but potentially cleaner textures.
tex_slat_sampling_steps.title: Tex Slat Sampling Steps

mesh_url.title: Mesh Url
mesh_url.description: URL of the untextured 3D mesh to retexture. Supports GLB, OBJ, PLY, and STL formats.

tex_slat_guidance_interval_end.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance ends for the texture stage. Must be >= tex_slat_guidance_interval_start.
tex_slat_guidance_interval_end.title: Tex Slat Guidance Interval End

tex_slat_rescale_t.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for texture generation. Higher values produce sharper texture details.
tex_slat_rescale_t.title: Tex Slat Rescale T

tex_slat_guidance_rescale.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in the texture stage. Increase if textures look noisy or have color banding.
tex_slat_guidance_rescale.title: Tex Slat Guidance Rescale

tex_slat_guidance_strength.description: How closely the texture follows the input image colors. Higher values produce more vivid but potentially oversaturated textures.
tex_slat_guidance_strength.title: Tex Slat Guidance Strength

tex_slat_guidance_interval_start.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance starts for the texture stage. Guidance is only applied between interval_start and interval_end.
tex_slat_guidance_interval_start.title: Tex Slat Guidance Interval Start

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Internal resolution for texture generation. Higher produces finer texture details but is slower.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
